name: Introduction and overview — KC-135 Stratotanker — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — KC-135 Stratotanker
description: Introduction and overview of the KC-135 Stratotanker: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The KC-135 Stratotanker is a four-engine aerial refueling tanker built by Boeing, entering service in 1957 alongside the B-52 it was designed to refuel. 803 were built. Re-engined as the KC-135R with CFM56 turbofans, the fleet has provided the backbone of U.S. air-to-air refueling for over six decades. Baseline facts: Four-engine aerial tanker; service from 1957; 803 built by Boeing; backbone of U.S. refueling..
